in_marathi.name: Sharjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे King of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sharjeet is derived from the Sanskrit words shri, which means king, and jay, which means victory. It is a name that signifies triumph and success.
